title: A Message in a Bottle
description: A girl finds a bottle on the beach with a message from a faraway boy.
instructions: Read the story about Mai and the bottle. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🍾 One windy morning, Mai was walking along the beach with her dog, Bobo. Suddenly, Bobo started to bark at something in the sand. It was an old green bottle.
Mai picked up the bottle and looked inside. There was a piece of paper in it! She pulled it out carefully, because it was wet. The writing was small, but she could read it.
The message said, 'Hello! My name is Leo. I am nine years old and I live in a small town in Spain. I put this bottle in the sea on 3rd May. Please write to me if you find it!'
Mai ran home to show her mum. 'Leo's bottle has travelled more than ten thousand kilometres!' said her mum. 'It must have been in the sea for a very long time.'
That afternoon, Mai wrote a long letter to Leo. She told him about her school, her family and her dog. She also put a photo of Bobo in the envelope, which made her smile.
Her mum helped her find Leo's address on the computer. Then they went to the post office. The man there said, 'Your letter will arrive in about two weeks.'
Three weeks later, a letter came for Mai. It was from Leo! He was very surprised that his bottle had arrived in Viet Nam. 'I have never had a friend in Asia before,' he wrote.
Now Mai and Leo write to each other every month. Next summer, Leo is going to visit Mai, and they will look for more bottles on the beach together.
